This standard is based on DIN 103 Blatt 8 (October 1972) Metrisches ISO � Trapezgewinde Grenzmasse fur Bolzengewinde Von 105 bis 300 mm Nenndurchmesser (ISO metric trapezoidal threads � Limits of sizes for external screw threads from 105 to 300 mm nominal diameter; limits of sizes, issued by Deutscher Normenausschuss (DNA). This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards on ISO metric trapezoidal screw threads. The other standards published so far in the series are: IS 7008 (Part 1):1999/ ISO 2901:1993 IS 7008 (Parf 2):1 988/ ISO 2902:1977 IS 7008 (Part 3):" 988/ ISO 2904:1977 IS 7008 (Part 4):' 999/ ISO 2903:1993 IS 7684:1975 IS 7685:1975 IS 7726:1975 (BP20)
Reprography Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
